by_turn.text: Uhm, so I've had this runny nose, well first it was a stuffy nose, but now I've had this runny nose for the past week and a half and it doesn't seem to be getting any better. So I was just wondering if you could give me something for that?
Uhm, it started getting stuffy about two weeks ago.
Yeah, that started a week and a half ago.
No, I haven't tried anything. I've been thinking about using some nasal decongestion but I don't want to make my runny nose any worse.
No dizziness, I feel like sometimes I have a headache though, because I feel like there's a lot of fluid or something backed up into my sinuses.
No, nothing like that, that I can think of.
I have some old carpets, but that's about it.
I had an arm fracture when I was younger, but that's it.
Once in a while I'll have like a glass of wine every week.
Uh, no, what can I do about this runny nose?
Yeah, that sounds great. Thank you so much.
